Part of the US$166.2m 'investment in associates' investing outflow. Per-deal consideration not separately disclosed in the AR.

Funded from the US$166.2m 'investment in associates' investing outflow (also covering the Frankfurt 24.9% associate step-up). Per-deal consideration not separately disclosed.
